subject.title: feat(durable): persist agent turn front doors

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new core durable-runtime configuration, shared-state persistence, recovery-worker, and fail-closed authority contract for the 2026.7.1 release line after the streaming admission defect is repaired?
rationale: This is a large new core capability with a new public configuration surface, persistent coordination state, owner-recovery behavior, and intentionally stricter behavior for enabled CLI users; code review cannot determine whether that product and upgrade contract should ship.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded durable core
options.body: Approve the opt-in durable contract after both HTTP streaming front doors delay success framing until durable authority intake is known to have succeeded.

options.title: Defer the core runtime direction
options.body: Keep the proposal and evidence available, but do not merge the persistent recovery and authority surface into the release until maintainers choose a narrower supported product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded durable core
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in durable contract after both HTTP streaming front doors delay success framing until durable authority intake is known to have succeeded.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the only concrete durable-stack routing candidate; final acceptance still requires an OpenClaw architecture/product owner.
